sources.entry: Awesome AI Startups - A curated list of bootstrapped, pre-seed, and angel-funded AI products built by independent founders.

summary.one_liner: A large curated directory of AI products built by independent founders (bootstrapped, pre-seed, or angel-funded), organized by category with one-line descriptions linking to each startup.
summary.what_it_does: The README is a categorized list of indie AI startups, each with a short tagline and description. Categories include Marketing/SEO/Sales, AI Agents & Assistants, Coding & Developer Tools, Audio/Voice/Music, Video, Image/Design/3D, Writing, Analytics, Productivity, Search, Education, Health, Finance/Crypto, APIs/SDKs/Infrastructure, Chatbots, Social, E-commerce, and Everything Else. Entries are mostly product pitches rather than descriptions of open-source code. The stated goal is to make useful indie AI products easier to find, and inclusion is through a pull request following contributing.md. The README is a list of links, not a tool to install, and the visible portion is truncated before the end of the list.
use_cases: Find indie AI products in a specific category
Discover bootstrapped AI tools for marketing or sales
Browse AI agent and assistant startups
Look for developer tools built by solo founders
Submit your own AI startup to a curated directory
notable: Organized into 18 category sections with per-category entry counts
Covers only independent, bootstrapped, pre-seed, or angel-funded products outside big AI labs
Contributions are accepted by pull request with inclusion criteria in contributing.md
Listed as part of the eudk/awesome-ai-tools collection
caveats: Entries are promotional one-liners that the README does not verify
The README is truncated, so the full list is not visible
Many listed products are closed-source SaaS, so the list is not a source of open-source tools
